root_cause: The 2026-03-14 payment-service v1.8.0 release enabled coupon handling. For roughly 40% of checkout requests, the frontend supplied couponCode as an empty string. CouponService.applyCoupon passed that empty string to CouponRepository.findByCode, received null, and dereferenced getPercent(), producing a NullPointerException and HTTP 500. The order-service retry cascade then produced PaymentFailedException and api-gateway 502 responses. Requests without the field and requests with valid coupon codes continued to succeed.

expected_timeline.event: notification-service v3.2.1 deployment and queue-depth decoy begin
payment-service v1.8.0 deployment and coupon flag activation
first new payment-service pod becomes Ready

expected_impact.affected_users_note: Requests with an empty couponCode failed quickly; requests without the field and valid coupon codes continued to succeed.

remediation_options.title: Disable feature flag coupon.enabled
remediation_options.why: Disabling the flag prevents the failing coupon path and takes effect without restarting pods.

remediation_options.title: Roll back payment-service to v1.7.4
remediation_options.why: The previous image removes the newly introduced coupon code path.

remediation_options.title: Scale up postgres-payments
remediation_options.why: Failed requests do not reach Postgres and its resource metrics remain healthy.

remediation_options.title: Restart payment-service pods
remediation_options.why: A restart does not change the faulty application code or feature flag.

remediation_options.title: Scale payment-service from 4 to 8 pods
remediation_options.why: Additional replicas run the same code path and do not prevent the exception.

smoking_gun_queries.expected_result: Payment-service 1.8.0 emits NullPointerException records with couponCode present and empty; each failed request has correlated order-service retries and gateway 502.
Failed checkout traces stop in payment-service and contain no postgres-payments span; healthy checkout traces do include Postgres.
DEP-001 rolls 1.7.4 to 1.8.0 and CFG-001 enables coupon.enabled at the same timestamp.

expected_verification: Disabling coupon.enabled at 10:12 should reduce errors below 1% by 10:14. Alternatively, rolling payment-service back to v1.7.4 should complete around 10:15:10 and reduce errors below 1% by 10:17. Database scaling, pod restarts, and replica scaling should not resolve the failures.
